title: CDM Lifecycle, Party and Security Model
description: State 009 order-management runtime with FINOS CDM 7.8.0 underneath: cdm-service is the system of record for parties, persons and securities and mirrors every order and trade event into lineage-linked CDM objects; existing services serve their simple shapes as projections with an optional cdmRef.

nodes.label: Developer / Trader
nodes.description: Uses the TraderX UI (including the CDM view) and REST APIs through the ingress.

nodes.label: External CDM Consumer
nodes.description: Any client reading CDM over /cdm-service/ REST or the cdm.* NATS subjects.

nodes.label: NGINX Ingress
nodes.description: Single origin on :8080; adds the /cdm-service/ route in this state.

nodes.label: Angular Trade UI
nodes.description: Trade and order tickets, blotters with CDM links, admin tab and the new CDM view (/cdm).

nodes.label: Account Service
nodes.description: Accounts and account users as projections of CDM Party objects (+ cdmRef); writes go through cdm-service.

nodes.label: People Service
nodes.description: Person directory as a projection of CDM NaturalPerson objects (+ cdmRef).

nodes.label: Reference Data
nodes.description: Stocks as projections of CDM Security objects (+ cdmRef).

nodes.label: Trade Service
nodes.description: Validates trades against account/reference data and passes the optional orderId to /trades.

nodes.label: Order Matcher
nodes.description: Order lifecycle (+ filledQuantity, canceledQuantity, cdmRef), fills with orderId, rejected requests on /orders/rejected, partial force-fill.

nodes.label: Trade Processor
nodes.description: Books trades and positions; publishes each committed trade on /trades/booked.

nodes.label: Position Service
nodes.description: Positions (+ cdmRef) and trades from the shared database.

nodes.label: CDM Service
nodes.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot / cdm-java 7.8.0. Party, person and security masters; lifecycle adapter (NATS -> WorkflowStep, BusinessEvent, TradeState); CDM validation; lineage, resolve, positions and diagnostics APIs; publishes cdm.* subjects.

nodes.label: NATS Broker
nodes.description: Pricing, trade, position and order subjects plus /trades/booked, /orders/rejected and cdm.workflow, cdm.events, cdm.tradestate.

nodes.label: Postgres
nodes.description: Shared database: 009 tables (trades.orderid, orderbook.canceledquantity added) plus cdm_documents, cdm_pending_trades, cdm_pending_cancels, cdm_lifecycle_failures.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Market prices for the matcher and UI (unchanged).

nodes.label: Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo)
nodes.description: Inherited LGTM stack; Prometheus scrapes cdm-service and blackbox probes its /health.

edges.label: CDM store, FK anchors, backfill reads
